title: cmd: rename --authfile to --auth-file; keep --authfile as alias
body:
Make `--auth-file` the canonical flag name for the authentication file across all Podman CLI commands. The old `--authfile` form is preserved as a backwards-compatible alias via `utils.AliasFlags` normalization.

Changes:
- `artifact/pull.go`, `artifact/push.go`: rename primary flag, add `SetNormalizeFunc(utils.AliasFlags)`, import utils package
- `kube/play.go`: rename primary flag (`SetNormalizeFunc` already present)
- `common/build.go`, `common/create.go`, `containers/create.go`, `containers/run.go`, `containers/runlabel.go`, `images/pull.go`, `images/push.go`, `images/search.go`, `images/sign.go`, `manifest/add.go`, `manifest/inspect.go`, `manifest/push.go`, `auto-update.go`, `login.go`, `logout.go`: rename flag and/or update example strings
- `utils/alias.go`: `authfile -> auth-file` alias preserved
- `vendor/go.podman.io/common/pkg/auth/cli.go`: use `auth-file`
- `vendor/go.podman.io/buildah/pkg/cli/common.go`: update `AliasFlags`
- `vendor/go.podman.io/buildah/pkg/parse/parse.go`: use `auth-file`
- docs: update all `--authfile` examples and flag descriptions
- tests: update primary tests to use `--auth-file`; add alias tests to verify `--authfile` backwards compatibility

Fixes: #20693
